tasks.label: Run Web Application (Start Server)
tasks.detail: Launches the C++ server on http://localhost:8080 and opens the browser

tasks.label: Build Web Server (server.exe)
args: set PATH=C:\tools\mingw64\bin;%PATH% && g++ -std=c++17 -static -Ibackend backend\main.cpp backend\database.cpp backend\sqlite3.o -lws2_32 -o server.exe
tasks.detail: Compiles the C++ web server into server.exe using MinGW g++
